SUCCESSOR-2 TOOLING FINDING (important, feeds RI-VIS09 §5): image-metrics.mjs FFT resamples the WHOLE frame to 256x256 before the transform (radialSpectrum -> resampleSquare(Y,w,h,256)). RI-VIS03 M5 specifies a NATIVE-RESOLUTION centre 1024x1024 crop. So HFR/NYQ/alpha from image-metrics are statistics of a heavy downscale and are resolution-dependent; they cannot be compared to RI-VIS03's M5 bands at all. Band edges also differ: image-metrics high_band_ratio = E(r/nyq in [0.25,1.0))/E(all), RI-VIS03 HFR = E(f in [0.20,0.45))/(E_LOW+E_MID+E_HIGH). NYQ_ratio is [0.5,1.0)/[0.25,1.0) vs RI-VIS03's [0.45,0.50)/[0.20,0.45) — which is why measured NYQ ~0.40 sits far above RI-VIS03's 0.18 max and means NOTHING. Also: image-metrics has NO FG_MASK, so sky is included in mean_Y, C_global, ED_1 and the flat fractions, whereas every RI-VIS03 band is FG-only. And M8 FS_score / LargestFlat (the two HARD FAIL statistics) are NOT COMPUTED BY ANY TOOL WE HAVE — flat_tile_frac is a 16px-tile count, not a 9x9 connected-component area.
